sql:
SELECT
  strftime(date_trunc('month', occurred_at), '%Y-%m') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS rows_in_live_table,
  (DATE '2026-01-05' - date_trunc('month', occurred_at)::date) AS days_old_as_of_report_date,
  CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-01-05' - date_trunc('month', occurred_at)::date) > 730 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS exceeds_730_day_retention
FROM audit_log
WHERE occurred_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND occurred_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', occurred_at)
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', occurred_at) ASC
note: Platform-wide (all tenants) monthly count of audit_log rows still in the live table, with age-from-month-start and the >730-day retention flag computed against the literal report date 2026-01-05. 36 rows (2023-01 through 2025-12).
